sheets.name: README
rows: Traceability view for one regulation-to-SHACL generation run.
Generation is frozen before RDF execution; no ship graph or hidden expected outcome is used here.
events.jsonl is append-only; CSV and Excel sheets are derived views.
Static validation passed and the semantic validator accepted the candidate.
No verified canonical term was available; the generator was not allowed to invent one.
Accepted shapes await the separate bulk evaluator.

sheets.name: RUNS
rows: The candidate faithfully encodes the direct-static implication: for a ship with designIceCondition equal to mediumFirstYearIceWithPossibleOldIceInclusions, shipCategory is present exactly once as polarShipCategoryA with no additional category value. Applicability input, required ship ownership, canonical namespace, target, range, and required cardinality are correctly represented. Deterministic validation is valid.

sheets.name: ITERATIONS
rows: Replace the restrictive sh:or enumeration with the direct implication: when ship designIceCondition is mediumFirstYearIceWithPossibleOldIceInclusions, shipCategory must be polarShipCategoryA; otherwise the rule must not require membership in the listed non-A conditions. The current second branch invents an exhaustive alternative enumeration and can reject valid designIceCondition values outside that list. Preserve the ship target and canonical terms, and retain the required designIceCondition applicability input.

The applicability implication and ship target are correct, and the prior instruction to avoid an exhaustive alternative enumeration is preserved. However, the SPARQL rule only requires that polarShipCategoryA be present; it permits additional shipCategory values, so it is a presence-only approximation of the required equality. Enforce that, when designIceCondition is mediumFirstYearIceWithPossibleOldIceInclusions, shipCategory equals polarShipCategoryA and no other category value is present (or otherwise encode the equivalent exact comparison), while retaining the required designIceCondition applicability input and canonical terms.

The candidate faithfully encodes the direct-static implication: for a ship with designIceCondition equal to mediumFirstYearIceWithPossibleOldIceInclusions, shipCategory is present exactly once as polarShipCategoryA with no additional category value. Applicability input, required ship ownership, canonical namespace, target, range, and required cardinality are correctly represented. Deterministic validation is valid.
